metadata.description: Local marketplace for the harness's Function Hooks (Mods) layer: the shared harness-runtime adapter and the harness-mods consumer.

plugins.name: harness-runtime
plugins.description: Shared Claude runtime adapter: the ONE plugin that reads Anthropic's raw function-hook events; publishes normalised ClaudeRuntimeEvents on runtime.emit and $.runtime.{emit,supports,judge,snapshot}.

plugins.name: harness-mods
plugins.description: The harness's Mod layer: session heartbeat + Mods canary, native session usage, rewrite explanations, measured subagent accounting, supervisor routing, secret redaction. Each guard runs classic | shadow_mod | mod per mods-config.json.
